prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: a burst pipe in winter. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"Where freezing temperatures are forecast, you must take reasonable steps to protect your home from escape of water.
